children: OGE Energy raised its quarterly dividend by less than 1% to 42.9 cents from 42.5 cents.
OGE expects earnings per share growth to outpace dividend growth in the next five years as it targets an updated payout ratio of 55% to 60%.
The new payout, equal to about $1.72 a year, represents an annual yield of 3.8% based on Wednesday's closing price of $44.71.
The electric utility company said the new dividend will be paid on Oct. 30 to shareholders of record as of Oct. 5.
